regions.label: <house 1>
regions.prompt: Two-story coastal-style house with dark gray cedar shingle siding and crisp white trim. The dark charcoal gabled roof features two prominent front-facing gables with white decorative truss-like patterns in the peaks. A covered front porch with a white-pillared portico and black railings spans the right side, accessed by a set of light gray stairs with black handrails. The windows are multi-paned with white frames; two large tripartite windows sit on the upper right, while smaller single and double-hung windows are distributed across the left facade and lower level. A white front door is visible under the porch roof. The house sits on a light gray concrete foundation.
